text: The CAREC DRTF features regional pooling across CAREC members, integration of the DRMI analytics platform, and the proposed ADB-sponsored Disaster Relief Bond. It aligns with CAREC’s climate agenda and regional public goods approach, offering a structured roadmap informed by member feedback, including Pakistan. The facility aims to move member countries from ad hoc, post-disaster budget reallocations to ex ante, risk-informed, and pooled disaster risk financing.

metadata.solution_name: CAREC Disaster Risk Transfer Facility (CAREC DRTF)
